objective: Phase 2, registered after the experiments-v1 results and disclosed as such. Phase 1 selected ViT-S/14 at 308 px with dihedral augmentation (E3). A larger backbone (E4, ViT-B/14) lowered cross-validated accuracy, and the remaining test errors are confusions between epidermis preparations of the two species, whose distinguishing structures (stomata, calcium oxalate crystals) span few patches. Phase 2 therefore tests ways to read finer detail without a larger backbone, within the same latency budget.
primary_metric: Out-of-fold accuracy from grouped, stratified 5-fold cross-validation on the development pool (train + validation splits).
adoption_rule: Rungs are evaluated in the registered order, each applying its change to the best configuration adopted so far. A rung is adopted if its encoding time fits the latency budget and its out-of-fold accuracy is higher than the current best, or equal with a lower out-of-fold log-loss. Rungs over the latency budget are evaluated and reported but cannot be adopted. Validation, test and held-out results are reported for every rung and are never used to decide adoption.
latency_rationale: Interactive screening: encoding one uploaded image (all views) must take at most 3 s on the reference laptop CPU (AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS).

baseline.title: Phase 1 selection (E3): ViT-S/14, 308 px, CLS, 8 dihedral views
baseline.hypothesis: Reference point carried over from experiments-v1.

ladder.title: Multi-block CLS pooling (last 4 blocks)
ladder.hypothesis: CLS tokens of earlier transformer blocks retain mid-level structure (cell outlines, stomatal and crystal shapes) that the final block abstracts away; concatenating the last four blocks is DINOv2's own linear-probe recipe.

ladder.title: Encoder resolution 448 px with four rotation views
ladder.hypothesis: Stomata and crystals span few patches at 308 px; 448 px (32 x 32 patches) resolves them. Four rotations keep encoding within the latency budget (measured 1,566 ms; eight views would take 3,133 ms).
